biotools.summary: FAVA (Functional Associations using Variational Autoencoders) is a software resource for inferring high-quality functional association networks from scRNA-seq and proteomics data. It addresses biases in existing methods by utilizing data unaffected by literature bias and offers a pipeline accessible via pip/PyPI and the scverse ecosystem.
